words.sense: Praise or approval that is excessive and uncritical.
misconceptions: Every heartfelt compliment counts as excessive adulation.

words.sense: Genuine favorable regard or respect without necessarily exaggerating.
misconceptions: Great respect cannot be strong unless it is worshipful.

semantic_axes.description: Whether praise is proportionate or wildly inflated.
Whether praise can coexist with noticing shortcomings.

edges.boundary_rule: Adulation is inflated or uncritical praise, while admiration can be warm and strong yet still proportionate and discriminating.
clues_a: claims a person can do no wrong

misconceptions.M1: Every heartfelt compliment counts as excessive adulation.
misconceptions.M2: Great respect cannot be strong unless it is worshipful.
misconceptions.M3: Loud or public praise by itself proves excess.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Imani’s response to her debate coach?

beats.text: Imani thanks her coach for teaching her to explain arguments more clearly.
beats.decisive_clue: specific praise for a useful skill
beats.reason: She appreciates identifiable help from her coach.

beats.text: She also points out that last week’s practice ended too early.
beats.decisive_clue: specific praise for a useful skill
beats.reason: Noticing a coaching weakness leaves her measured appreciation intact.

chains.feedback_short: Noticing a coaching weakness leaves her measured appreciation intact.
chains.feedback_deep: She appreciates identifiable help from her coach. Noticing a coaching weakness leaves her measured appreciation intact. Admiration respects merit; adulation puts it beyond criticism.
chains.contrast_rule: Admiration respects merit; adulation puts it beyond criticism.

hints.attention: Can she praise without overlooking flaws?
hints.axis: Whether praise is proportionate or wildly inflated.
hints.contrast: Admiration respects merit; adulation puts it beyond criticism.

beats.text: Owen calls the singer brilliant and refuses to believe any performance could be weak.

beats.text: He describes a missed note as proof of even greater genius.
beats.decisive_clue: explains away an obvious mistake as perfection
beats.reason: Turning a mistake into more praise makes his uncritical excess especially clear.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Diego’s praise of the director?

beats.text: Diego insists every frame of the director’s film belongs in a museum.
beats.decisive_clue: sweeping praise of every film frame
beats.reason: He declares flawless excellence without limits.

beats.text: He says the confusing ending cannot be questioned because its maker is incapable of error.
beats.decisive_clue: treats the maker as incapable of error
beats.reason: His refusal to consider a confusing ending confirms that his praise has passed beyond critical respect.
